title: Barcelona without Raphinha: Gabriel Jesus takes over attack against Getafe
seoTitle: Barcelona without Raphinha: Jesus starts vs Getafe
subtitle: Raphinha's injury leads coach to field the Brazilian in upcoming LaLiga matches
excerpt: Raphinha was sidelined for Barcelona due to a thigh injury, and coach Hansi Flick decided to put Gabriel Jesus as the offensive reference against Getafe.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazilian forward Raphinha has been ruled out of Barcelona's upcoming clash against Getafe after feeling a strain in his right thigh during the national team's friendly against Australia. The injury, although not serious, led coach Hansi Flick to opt for caution and preserve the player to avoid relapses.

Raphinha out for the next two fixtures

Flick confirmed that Raphinha will play neither in the duel against Getafe nor in the Champions League match against Galatasaray. The club has maintained maximum caution, considering that the athlete suffered three injuries in the same region last year.

Gabriel Jesus as a starter

With Raphinha's absence, Gabriel Jesus was announced as a starter against Getafe. The former Arsenal player has 41 minutes across four matches for Barcelona, but has already scored two goals, demonstrating efficiency in front of goal.

Other attacking options

Flick also has other alternatives at his disposal, such as Hamza Abdelkarim, Olmo, Adeyemi, Gordon, and youngster Lamine Yamal, who can be used in future clashes, including in the Champions League.

Impact on Barcelona's performance

Even with Raphinha's loss, Barcelona remains at the top of LaLiga, with 21 points out of a possible 21 and 31 goals scored. The next game aims to equal the club's best historical start in the competition.

Details of the match against Getafe

The clash will take place at the Spotify Camp Nou at 6:30 PM, for the eighth matchday of LaLiga. Barcelona arrives at the duel with a solid defense, having conceded only seven goals in the first seven rounds. Getafe, in turn, occupies 11th position with eight points.

With information from MARCA, Mundo Deportivo, Teleprensa.
